objective: Project durable quoted and bound outcome attainment by the same canonical acquisition dimensions already used by economics aggregation.
inputs: one attributed relationship view per canonical cohort relationship
explicit durable quoted and bound outcome facts
rules: Relationship IDs are canonically validated and deduplicated.
Exactly one attributed view must exist for every canonical cohort relationship.
No attributed view may exist outside the explicit cohort.
Presentation relationship identity must match its attributed view relationship identity.
Missing presentation or missing selected dimension value is grouped into the absent dimension bucket.
Outcome facts are globally validated against the explicit cohort by canonical INS-003S analytics.
Outcome facts are partitioned by relationship and then projected through canonical INS-003S analytics for each dimension bucket.
Exact quote and bind fractions are projected through INS-003V for each bucket.
Repeated durable outcome facts count once at relationship level while fact counts remain preserved.
quoteStatus is segmentation metadata only and never creates quoted or bound outcome evidence.
Buckets are deterministic by dimension value with the absent bucket last.
No SQL, persistence access, persistence mutation, percentage formatting, floating-point division, or rounding is introduced.
